title: Reproducibility package: cross-session calibration and backdoor robustness in EEG motor-imagery BCI (CRCS)
description:
Code, configurations, derived result tables, subject-level outputs, publication-facing result figures, and revision-stage reproducibility audit supporting Toward Deployable Brain–Computer Interfaces: A Computational Review and Cross-Session Study of Calibration, Generalization, and Security.

The package contains Phase-I to Phase-III notebooks and extracted scripts, archived numerical result files, and explicit audit ledgers documenting the complete 6,075-row revision-stage rerun. The final audit is reported as a qualified reproduction: 6,066/6,075 rows reproduced completely, nine rows contained 34 numerical-field differences, and there were zero Phase-III discrepancies at the pre-specified 15% primary removal budget. The included PNGs are 600-dpi RGB publication-facing renderings generated from the released numerical result tables; the CSV/JSON files are the canonical numerical record.

BCI Competition IV Dataset 2a is not redistributed; it is accessed through MOABB as BNCI2014_001.

notes: Code is MIT licensed. Author-derived result tables and audit ledgers are CC BY 4.0. BCI Competition IV Dataset 2a is not redistributed. The retained notebooks and the independent revision-stage audit used the same pinned scientific-library versions but different Python 3.13 patch releases; this distinction is documented in README.md. The exact post-audit scientific supporting snapshot cited by the final manuscript is Git commit d99befd83ff256e9879e3eb87f6654deb205a1b4. The executed notebooks, numerical CSV/JSON outputs, revision-audit ledgers, and phase master scripts carried into this public release are unchanged from the corresponding audited artifacts. The 14 PNG result figures are publication-facing derivatives regenerated from those archived numerical tables with manuscript-aligned styling, RGB encoding, and 600-dpi output. Manuscript, reviewer, editor, journal-submission, and raw benchmark files are excluded.
